tokenizers.label: Chars / 4
tokenizers.note: Rough baseline: Math.ceil(UTF-16 code units / 4), not a model tokenizer.

tokenizers.label: OpenAI o200k_base
tokenizers.note: Exact o200k_base encoding counts; the closest public encoding for current Sol/Astra-era OpenAI GPT models. No chat or tool envelope is added.

tokenizers.label: Kimi K2 tiktoken
tokenizers.note: Exact published Kimi K2 BPE counts using the official pattern translated from Python regex to JavaScript. No chat template, BOS/EOS or tool envelope is added.

tokenizers.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
tokenizers.note: No official offline tokenizer is published for current Claude models. An optional owner run of bench/tokens/count-anthropic.mjs can use the count_tokens endpoint.

tokenizers.label: Claude Opus 5.5
tokenizers.note: No official offline tokenizer is published for current Claude models. An optional owner run of bench/tokens/count-anthropic.mjs can use the count_tokens endpoint.
